notes.claim: On an IT system with a first earth fault, the healthy phases rise to root three times the normal phase voltage.
In an IT system the first earth fault passes only milliamps and causes no disconnection.
Equipment on an insulated system is rated at 173% of the phase voltage, the line voltage, so its insulation can hold a first earth fault.

sources.title: IT system - Fault protection - Electrical Installation Guide
sources.quote: In IT system, the first fault to earth should not cause any disconnection. The earth-fault current which flows under a first-fault condition is measured in mA.

sources.title: IT system - Fault protection - Electrical Installation Guide
sources.quote: The voltages of the healthy phases have (because of the fault) increased to √3 times the normal phase voltage

sources.title: Low-voltage high resistance grounding systems basics
sources.quote: The equipment rating has to be rated at 173% of their line-to-neutral voltages.
